hypothesis: det Phi(s) = 1 exactly; its numerical drift measures each method: Euler drifts at O(h) through the per-step factor 1 + h^2 K, and RK4 drifts at O(h^4) or better.
mathematical_model: Phi' = A(s) Phi with A = [[0, 1], [-K, 0]] and tr A = 0 (Liouville). Step matrices: Euler [[1, h], [-h K_n, 1]]; midpoint det = 1 + h^2 (K_mid - K_n)/2 + h^4 K_n K_mid/4; RK4 det - 1 has no h^1..h^5 terms for smooth K (sympy) and equals -h^6 K^3/72 + h^8 K^4/576 for constant K.
numerical_result: Drift orders: euler sphere-great-circle 1.21, hyperbolic-long 0.964, torus-outer-equator 1.19, torus-inner-equator 0.841, torus 0.992, gaussian-bump 0.995, saddle 1, bump-radial 1.02, torus-outer-to-inner 0.996; midpoint sphere-great-circle 3.01, hyperbolic-long 3, torus-outer-equator 3.01, torus-inner-equator 3.01, torus 2, gaussian-bump 2, saddle 2.01, bump-radial 2, torus-outer-to-inner 1.98; rk4 sphere-great-circle 4.99, hyperbolic-long 5, torus-outer-equator 4.99, torus-inner-equator 5.01, torus 5, gaussian-bump 4.99, saddle 5, bump-radial 4.99, torus-outer-to-inner 5.02; Euler per-step factor error 4.82e-16; midpoint boundary ratio 0.9569..1.004 at N = 200; adaptive median drift slope 1.03.
observation_model: max over nodes of |det Phi - 1| with det = j_lat j_head' - j_lat' j_head.

title: Measure the Wronskian and transfer-matrix determinant.
uncertainty: Fitted orders over four halvings; the exact per-step predictions hold to rounding once scaled by |a b'| + |a' b| (the columns reach cosh(6.5) on the inner equator). Euler slopes on the long constant-curvature paths are not fitted claims: (1 + h^2 K)^(L/h) - 1 ~ exp(h L K) - 1 is not yet linear in h when h L |K| is near 1, so the exact product formula is checked there instead.
unresolved_assumptions: The O(h^6) RK4 per-step defect is derived for smooth K(s) along the stage points; paths through curvature discontinuities were not tested
